name: AppleCreatures
summary: New creatures made by combining library pieces: a rigged body wears a costume (a vegetable, a fruit, any prop) in place of its torso and head, so a twist like "the enemies are vegetables" is really built.

needs.config: AppleGameConfig.creatures: { name = { body, costume, into, upright?, limbColor?, scale? } } (paths to library models the composer imported)
needs.bodies: rigged bodies with Motor6D limbs (MythicNPC, the R15 Dummy, the Penguin family)
needs.boot: runs before AppleBoot prepares the containers, so the new creatures are animated too

gives.creatures: one model per entry in its `into` container, e.g. ServerStorage.AppleEnemies.Carrot, with the costume welded on and the limbs walking
